rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for moving on ice or the ground with skates.

example.english: I like to skate on weekends.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 zau1 mut6 heoi3 lau6 bing1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an ice skate or skating shoe.

example.english: I had trouble standing steadily the first time I put on a skate.
example.traditional: 我第一次著冰鞋，仲企唔穩。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 zoek3 bing1 haai4 zung6 kei5 m4 wan2

rows.note: Use this for the flat-bodied ray known in English as a skate fish, especially as food.

example.traditional: 呢種魟魚煎香咗食好好味㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 hung4 jyu4 zin1 hoeng1 zo2 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on gliding smoothly along a surface rather than on skating as an activity.

example.english: We skate smoothly across the ice.
example.traditional: 我哋沿住冰面滑行，感覺好順。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jyun4 zyu6 bing1 min6 waat6 hang4 gam2 gok3 hou2 seon6
